question: Does a faithful full-CSR fallback for all specialized receiver rows fit the residual six-sweep budget of the proposed multirate block?
measurement: Exact base-CSR incidence of the conservative union of owner-overridden rows, patched-weight destinations, and all destinations of substituted sources. Count each graph edge once in the union, plus each category separately. Compare one full-row fallback pass with the 0.273-sweep nominal remainder. This is an edge-count gate, not a runtime benchmark or proof that a custom owner kernel cannot fit.

thresholds_frozen.decision: If one full-row fallback pass exceeds the residual fraction, rule out that fallback within A's six-sweep first-block contract. Otherwise retain only as unmeasured candidate.

rivals.A: Versioned continuous/event split with specialized owner callbacks; full-row fallback is the conservative first implementation measured here.
rivals.B: Spatial compression/partition with exact residual; cost depends on cut and cannot be inferred from this receiver-row count.
rivals.C: Exact native runtime preserves the old coefficient; this test does not estimate its wall time.
